title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 09
description:
Embrace your passion for baseball with the Jeminise Personalized Baseball Comforter Set. This custom bedding set allows you to add a unique touch to your room, celebrating your love for the sport with comfort and style.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your name to create a truly unique baseball-themed comforter set.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Material Details: Crafted from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel. Features whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing. It's recommended to wash in a mesh laundry bag.
  • Thoughtful Gift: An ideal gift for baseball players, fans, and lovers for men and women, parents, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Product Style: Features a dynamic baseball pattern, perfect for sports enthusiasts.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Baseball Glove
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
